Definition: Youth employment. Share of employees aged 30 years and below in total employees.
Firm AI adoption. Natural logarithm of one plus the frequency of AI-related keywords in the annual report.
Business model innovation. Length-adjusted frequency of business-model-innovation terms in the annual report, min–max normalized to [0, 1].
Firm skill structure. Share of employees holding a bachelor’s degree or above.
Digital entrepreneurial orientation. Length-adjusted frequency of entrepreneurial-orientation and digital terms, min–max normalized to [0, 1].
Sustainability performance. Huazheng (SinoSecurities) ESG rating converted to a 1–9 numerical scale.
Public AI and digital-economy governance. Dummy equal to 1 if the firm’s city is a national big-data or AI innovation pilot zone, and 0 otherwise.
Firm age. Natural logarithm of the current year minus the year of incorporation plus one.
Firm size. Natural logarithm of total assets at year-end.
Leverage. Total liabilities divided by total assets.
Return on assets. Net profit divided by total assets.
Net cash flow from operating activities divided by total assets.
Sales growth. Growth rate of operating revenue.
Ownership concentration. Shares held by the top ten shareholders divided by total shares.
Board size. Natural logarithm of the number of board directors.
CEO–chair separation. Dummy equal to 1 if the CEO and board chair are different persons, and 0 otherwise.
State ownership. Dummy equal to 1 if the firm is state-owned, and 0 otherwise.
Natural logarithm of the GDP of the city where the firm is registered.
